The coherent adaptive policy ties its selected fixed order and myopic control on every observed path at all budgets. At budgets 2 and 3 its macro J is 157023/457520, approximately 0.34321. At budget 3 the empirical adaptive J is 1364/4515 and statewise J is 10141/39216; coherent therefore regresses by 8059/196080 and 58067/686280 respectively. Figure 4 shows the full budget contrast, including budget 1 ties. We do not headline the older exposed-DEV positive as the latest matched result.

예산3에서 coherent J는157023/457520≈0.34321, empirical은1364/4515≈0.30210, statewise는10141/39216≈0.25859다. 낮을수록 좋은 값이므로 새 coherent는 둘보다 나쁘다. 자신의 강한 fixed-order와 myopic과는 모든 예산에서 실제 경로까지 동률이다. 내부 일관성을 성능 개선으로 적을 수 없다.
